description: Homes: prepare (unsigned) a raid on someone else's apartment with a squad of 2 to 4 (you first). The kit goes to the pool and is lost if the raid fails; the result is a drand round about 30 s later (then prepare_raid_resolve). Optional roles: 1 Driver, 2 Hacker, 3 Muscle, 4 Face, 5 Inside Agent (0 none). There are 5 role ids but only 4 seats, so a squad never carries all five. Role bonuses apply only if the admin switch is on (city_state.switches.apartmentRaidRoleBonuses; the pipeline turns it on for the next testnet round, mainnet stays closed). Each squad member's approval expires after 1 day: renew your yes daily (prepare_approve_leader) or the raid is refused. No weapons and no items in an apartment raid. Not the same game as the Season 1 crew raid or the older 3-to-5 squad raid.

apartmentId.description: The apartment to raid (must be raidable).

members.description: Crew wallets, YOU first (each other member must have called prepare_approve_leader for you). Omit to go alone where the game allows. The size limit is per game: night_run 1-4, convoy 1-5, ledger 2-5, vehicle_heist 3-5, raid 2-4.

roles.description: One role number per member, same order. Role ids differ per game (see this tool's description).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_raid_launch
